phase: before viewing per-pair numeric scores or released labels in this run
fallback_subject_check: A_subject_unrestricted (existing cached source-only automatic selection, same unrestricted matcher)
fixed_qualitative_gate: eligible in source_eligibility_frozen.json only; gate based on images/instructions/source support, not scores or labels
manual_gate_limitation: This is an AI-assisted per-case triage diagnostic, not a learned or autonomous trigger. C010 tests only represented vehicle identity core; crop limits remain.
numeric_rule: For eligible cases only, B1 and source-region winners must disagree; decompose canonical A-minus-B mean similarity into K/N*foreground mean difference and (N-K)/N*complement mean difference. Switch to existing source-region winner only when foreground contribution favors that winner, complement contribution favors B1, and complement magnitude exceeds foreground magnitude, with finite, non-negligible contributions.
epsilon_role: fixed numerical roundoff guard; not fitted or varied
no_radius_constraint: Both heads use unrestricted source-to-candidate maximum cosine. Existing B3 radius2 remains paused.
unknown_policy: Unreliable regions or ambiguous scene, when heads disagree, produce unable and preserve B1; they remain in metric denominator. Same-winner controls remain unchanged.
outcome_priority: region unreliable or visual uncertainty -> unable, retain B1
eligible + verified opposition -> existing subject check
credit: released A/B winner; ties0.5, invalid0, no exclusions
count_categories: rescued/new_error/unchanged/unable mutually exclusive; unable cases keep baseline credit and remain in denominator
stop: One fixed batch, one rule, one final label evaluation. If net rescued-new_error<=0, stop and archive; do not try a new threshold, mask, batch or correspondence setting. Positive diagnostic net alone still cannot justify expansion without independent evidence.
